summary: Brightstar Lottery PLC (NYSE: BRSL) priced €500 million of 4.875% senior secured notes due 2032 at 99.360% of par, with settlement expected September 17, 2026. Proceeds will fund the purchase of Regulation S interests in its 2.375% senior secured notes due 2028 under a tender offer announced September 8, 2026, repay revolver borrowings and pay fees. The notes are guaranteed on a senior basis by certain wholly-owned subsidiaries and will list on Euronext Dublin's Global Exchange Market. The offering is not registered in the US. Watch tender acceptance levels and refinancing economics versus the 2028 notes.
